nodes.label: Release workflow: publish to Maven Central Portal
nodes.rationale: Triggered on release creation; server-id 'central' must match publishingServerId in the makeRelease profile. GPG passphrase is passed as MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE rather than -Dgpg.passphrase so it never appears in the process argument list; CENTRAL_USERNAME/PASSWORD are Central Portal user tokens, not renamed OSSRH credentials.
